about.title: Mina De Oro Ghana
about.subtitle: A modern gold mining operation in Ghana's Eastern Region, combining cutting-edge LiDAR 3D drone technology with environmentally responsible surface mining to deliver pure gold to global markets.
about.historyDesc: Mina De Oro Ghana was registered in 2025 in accordance with the Ghanaian Minerals and Mining Act, following the national re-registration policy. Our mining license covers a total area of approximately 405 hectares comprising 1,000 mining concessions in one of Ghana's most prolific gold-producing regions — the Eastern Region, located 100 kilometers from the capital, Accra.
about.visionDesc: To be Ghana's leading technology-driven gold mining company, recognized for deploying LiDAR 3D drone technology and environmentally responsible surface mining methods that set new standards for the African mining industry.
about.missionDesc: To extract and process high-grade gold deposits using advanced mining drones with LiDAR laser 3D technology and non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery methods — creating lasting value for our shareholders, communities, and the environment.
about.valuesDesc: Environmental responsibility, technological innovation, community partnership, transparency, and uncompromising safety standards guide every aspect of our operations.

timeline.foundingDesc: Mina De Oro Ghana registered under the Ghanaian Minerals and Mining Act, securing mining licenses covering 405 hectares with 1,000 concessions in the Eastern Region.
timeline.technologyDesc: Deployment of advanced mining drones equipped with LiDAR laser 3D technology for precise geological mapping and resource estimation.
timeline.operationsDesc: Launch of surface gold mining operations utilizing non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery methods with tailing dams management.
timeline.resourceDesc: Completion of mineral resource estimate by Mining Plus using LiDAR 3D technology, diamond drilling (DDH), reverse circulation (RC), and rotary air drilling.
timeline.productionDesc: Achieved average grade of 10 g/t gold in high-grade deposit areas, establishing the operation as a significant producer in Ghana's Eastern Region.
timeline.expansionDesc: Development of additional processing capacity and exploration of new concession areas to scale production and maximize resource recovery.

about.geologyDesc: The property is located at the Au-Ag epithermal belt in the Eastern Region of Ghana. The mineralization identified is of the high-sulfidation epithermal type, hosted in volcanic rocks, alluvial and illuvial deposits near the Eastern Region gold deposit belts. The Eastern Region is a major geological gold mining area with significant deposits.
about.resourcesDesc: Mineral resources have been estimated by Mining Plus using LiDAR laser 3D technology, diamond drill holes (DDH), reverse circulation drill holes (RC), supplemented by rotary air drilling (longholes) in areas with limited assay data. The resource is subhorizontal, outcrops or is found near the surface, and has been shown to be extractable by surface gold mining methods with a low waste/ore ratio.
about.cutOffDesc: A cut-off grade of 0.1 g/t Au was used within a surface gold mining design along with a low waste-to-ore ratio, estimated using a gold price of US$4,069.
about.recoveryRateDesc: An estimated recovery for gold of 90% is assumed with optimized operating costs.
about.teamDesc: Our operations are managed by experienced mining professionals with deep expertise in Ghanaian gold mining operations and modern extraction technologies.
about.ctaDesc: Mina De Oro Ghana is committed to becoming a leader in technology-driven, environmentally responsible gold mining in Africa.

operations.title: Mining Operations
operations.subtitle: Advanced surface gold mining operations in Ghana's Eastern Region, leveraging LiDAR 3D drone technology, modern extraction methods, and environmentally responsible non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery processes.
operations.openPitDesc: Our surface gold mining operations utilize advanced mining drones with LiDAR laser 3D technology for precise deposit mapping and extraction planning. The operation is designed with a low waste-to-ore ratio, optimizing resource recovery while minimizing environmental impact.
operations.explorationDesc: Systematic exploration programs using diamond drill holes (DDH), reverse circulation drill holes (RC), and rotary air drilling (longholes) to identify and delineate mineral resources across our 405-hectare concession area.
operations.processingDesc: On-site processing facilities employing modern crushing, grinding, and recovery technologies to efficiently liberate and recover gold from extracted ore.
operations.recoveryDesc: Our proprietary non-mercury, cyanide-free gold recovery process produces pure gold, setting new environmental standards for surface mining operations in West Africa.
operations.goldRecoveryDesc: Advanced gold recovery using non-mercury, cyanide-free methods to produce pure gold — eliminating the environmental and health risks associated with traditional mercury-based processing.
operations.flowDesc: From LiDAR-assisted exploration to non-mercury gold recovery, our integrated process ensures maximum efficiency and environmental responsibility at every stage.
operations.flowExplorationDesc: Mining drones with LiDAR laser 3D technology for geological mapping
operations.flowMiningDesc: Extraction with low waste-to-ore ratio using advanced drone-guided methods
operations.flowProcessingDesc: Crushing, grinding and modern recovery technology
operations.flowRecoveryDesc: Cyanide-free pure gold production with tailings management
operations.safetyDesc: Our operations fully comply with the Ghanaian Minerals and Mining Act and adhere to international safety and environmental standards, ensuring the well-being of our workforce and surrounding communities.
operations.safetyItem1: Full compliance with Ghana Minerals and Mining Act regulations
operations.safetyItem2: Non-mercury, cyanide-free processing eliminating health hazards
operations.safetyItem3: LiDAR 3D drone technology reducing manual exposure in hazardous areas
operations.safetyItem4: Tailing dams designed to international environmental standards

sustainability.title: Sustainability & Environmental Responsibility
sustainability.subtitle: Our commitment to responsible mining extends beyond production — we use non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery methods and advanced LiDAR technology to minimize our environmental footprint.
sustainability.environmentDesc: Non-mercury, cyanide-free gold recovery process eliminates toxic chemical discharge. Tailing dams designed to international standards prevent environmental contamination. Surface mining with low waste-to-ore ratio minimizes land disturbance.
sustainability.communityDesc: Operating in the heart of Ghana's Eastern Region mining community, we invest in local infrastructure, employment, and sustainable development programs that benefit surrounding communities.
sustainability.safetyDesc: LiDAR 3D drone technology reduces human exposure in hazardous mining areas. Our non-mercury process eliminates the health risks associated with traditional gold recovery methods.
sustainability.educationDesc: Skills development programs training local workforce in modern mining technologies, drone operation, and LiDAR data analysis, creating employment opportunities in our host communities.
sustainability.healthcareDesc: Community health programs and partnerships with regional healthcare providers ensure access to medical services for our workforce and surrounding communities.

products.title: Gold Products
products.subtitle: Premium quality pure gold produced through our non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery process — meeting international standards for purity and certification.
products.doreDesc: High-purity gold bars produced at our on-site smelting facility using our proprietary non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery process. Each bar is individually weighed, numbered, and accompanied by a certificate of origin and assay report.
products.concentrateDesc: High-grade gold concentrate produced through our modern processing circuits, suitable for further refining by international smelters and refiners.
products.exportDesc: Full-service gold export capabilities including secure logistics, customs documentation, international banking facilitation, and compliance with all Ghanaian and international regulatory requirements.
products.purityDesc: Our non-mercury, cyanide-free process produces gold of exceptional purity. Certified assay reports are provided for every shipment, with recovery rates of 90% at a cut-off grade of 0.1 g/t Au.
products.tradingDesc: Established trading relationships with leading international refineries and bullion banks across London, Zurich, Dubai, and Singapore, positioning Ghanaian gold in global markets.
products.environmentalDesc: Unlike conventional gold recovery using mercury and cyanide, our proprietary process produces pure gold without toxic chemicals — making our products uniquely attractive to environmentally conscious buyers.
